notes.title: Unlimited and Custom Mode!
notes.content:
[h1]New Mode![/h1]
[b]Endless mode is here![/b] Unlock this mode after beating the game and test your skills in an ultimate survival challenge which gets progressively harder the longer you survive.
[list]
[*] Including an all new [b]Leaderboard:[/b] compare your skills against friends (and foes), the fish who made the game, and the rest of the world! Topple them all and prove definitively that you alone are the best Engineer to ever brave Widow’s Run.
[/list]

[h3]Endless also includes a new [b]Custom mode[/b], in which you can:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Set Monster Difficulty:[/b] Each individual monster can be set between Easy, Medium, Hard, and Insane. (Or you can turn them off entirely)
[*] [b]Set Train Speed:[/b] For those who want a relaxing stress free mode of transportation. (You can now feed your firebox a little coal, as a treat :))
[*] [b]Track Your Distance:[/b] See exactly how far you have traveled through the snowy mountains.
[*] [b]Set Location:[/b] Speed through your favorite chapter locales on demand!
[/list]

[h3]Updated Stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*] New option to limit FPS for our [b]amazing streamers![/b]
[*] Wyverns munching on your train will now cause steam to escape from the engine (visually)
[*] You can turn the lantern on and off 🔥
[*] Ding!
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Camera shake between chapters has been removed due to popular demand
[*] Fixed widescreen view in main menu
[*] Fixed sparks showing up when you hit the track switch
[/list]

*The Mac Build will be updated in around a week :) (Our Mac that we use to build on is currently unavailable, oops)

notes.title: Localizations and Achievement Fixes!
notes.content:
Update for version 1.0.11 - January 17th, 2025
[list]
[*] Added language localization support for Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), and Simplified Chinese
[*] Fixed performance issue during first chapter cutscene that would consistently cause the game to stutter
[*] Fixed achievements not showing up until the game has been closed - they now show up when they're supposed to :)
[*] Made the ending music less occluded by environment sounds
[*] Some general bug fixes
[/list]

The Mac version will be updated with these changes within the next couple of days
